question:
Namespace `catalog` contains six star-catalog indexer Pods (`idx-*`) that carry `tier` and `survey` labels and various annotations.

1. On every Pod currently labelled `tier=ingest`, change the value of the label `tier` to `stream`.
2. On every Pod labelled `survey=wide`, add the annotation `catalog.observatory.io/retention` with the exact value `hot=7d,cold=365d`.
3. Write the names of all Pods in the namespace that carry the annotation `catalog.observatory.io/legacy-schema` (whatever its value) to `/home/candidate/exam/q10/legacy-schema-pods.txt`: one Pod name per line, sorted alphabetically, nothing else. Only this exact annotation key counts.

Do not change any other labels or annotations.

verification.description: Former tier=ingest pods now have tier=stream; other tier labels unchanged
legacy-schema-pods.txt lists exactly the pods annotated catalog.observatory.io/legacy-schema, sorted
